purpose: Record which unified target-discovery/downstream design tasks are complete and which remaining actions are blocked on future evidence or explicit authority, preventing repeated redesign, artificial rare-vs-regular separation and duplicate ETL.

cross_lane_provenance.PR311: Analysis/provenance lane for real-TRAIN rare-biology integration and Stage75 detection-residual regulatory-tail findings.
cross_lane_provenance.PR312: Active unified target-discovery integration/adjudication surface consuming PR311 plus all common/rare multimodal reconciliation contracts.
cross_lane_provenance.rule: PR311 -> PR312 is one evidence lineage; rare and regular biology are one TD project, not separate target-discovery programs.

completed_design_work.unified_target_portfolio: Target discovery now ends in an explicit qualified target-portfolio decision, not a mandatory single winner. C1 shared/global, C3 query/contextual, C2 relational if active, and qualified specialists may coexist when non-redundant; C6/C4 are possible fused implementations subject to block accountability.
completed_design_work.multi_teacher_student_architecture: Multiple evidence-specialized teachers and student heads/experts are allowed under a shared biological core. Separate full students must be earned by stable negative transfer, incompatible evidence interfaces or incompatible support/abstention geometry; half-capacity dual-student default and architecture zoo remain rejected.
completed_design_work.candidate_architecture: C1/C2/C3/C6/C4 foundation architecture with C5 specialist retained; dependencies and non-rescue rules preserved.
completed_design_work.corrected_replay_integration: Macha PR310 remains canonical replay package; this lane consumes its eventual audited outcome and does not duplicate execution machinery.
completed_design_work.regular_and_rare_unification: Common, continuous, intermediate-frequency and rare biology are assessed within the same active target blocks and same downstream multimodal chain; rarity is a cross-cutting biological regime, not a separate TD lane.
completed_design_work.regular_program_multimodal_reconciliatio: GSE214979 same-nucleus RNA+ATAC, Morabito donor-level recurrence, SCENIC/Stage75 interpretation, internal SEA-AD corroboration, spatial/perturbation follow-up and RNA-recoverable vs stochastic vs teacher-private decomposition are frozen for ordinary/continuous biology.
completed_design_work.rare_program_multimodal_reconciliation: The same pathway applies to rare biology, with additional source/operator/prevalence and measurement-shortcut challenges where rarity makes confounding especially likely.
completed_design_work.rare1_rare5_reconciliation: Historical rare1/rare5 are one strongly source-shifted diagnostic direction requiring source/operator-aware reassessment before use.
completed_design_work.stage75_rare_lead_handoff: PR311 Stage75 detection-residual result is folded into PR312; STAT1 is the priority prospective rare-program probe, not a separate target project and not target authority.
completed_design_work.bayesian_reuse: Useful PR249 dependency-ledger/calibration principles retained; failed pooled stage-mean recurrence estimand and sampler rejected.
completed_design_work.multimodal_evidence_ledger: Existing FULL104, Stage81A3, GSE214979, Morabito, SEA-AD multiome, regulatory, spatial and perturbation assets assigned roles with reuse/no-reacquisition rules.
completed_design_work.rich_teacher_partial_student: Target blocks share recoverable/stochastic/teacher-private decomposition, uncertainty and support semantics.
completed_design_work.authority_ladder: Replay -> block qualification -> complementarity/redundancy/interference adjudication -> protected confirmation -> explicit target-portfolio decision -> post-freeze multimodal decomposition -> representation/teacher-student topology decision -> later authorities.
completed_design_work.contingency_pivot_law: Major PASS/FAIL/NOT_ESTIMABLE/divergence/artifact outcomes have predeclared pivots and non-rescue rules.

remaining_execution_actions.blocked_on: exact PR310 owner ratification/launch acceptance and one authorized execution
remaining_execution_actions.notes: Determines C2/C4 status only; C1/C3/C6 continue independently.

remaining_execution_actions.blocked_on: separate explicit execution authority and authenticated TRAIN/cached surfaces
remaining_execution_actions.notes: Assess common and rare biological programs together; prioritize PR311 STAT1/SPI1 rare probes while retaining ordinary/continuous program controls and historical rare1/rare5 as confounded diagnostics.

remaining_execution_actions.blocked_on: candidate readouts plus common/rare reassessment evidence
remaining_execution_actions.notes: Each active block must preserve relevant common and rare biology and pass shortcut/transfer/support gates.
Determine whether qualified blocks should remain separate, be fused by C6/C4, or drop as redundant. Multiple qualified blocks do not force a single winner.
Owner may authorize one block, multiple complementary blocks, or an accountable fused implementation. No automatic promotion from survivor count.

remaining_execution_actions.notes: Partition each privileged increment into RNA-recoverable, stochastic or teacher-private components.

definition_of_design_lane_done: Unified TD now has target-block, target-portfolio, common/rare biology, multi-teacher/student, multimodal reconciliation, recoverability and authority semantics frozen prospectively. Remaining work is execution/audit unless a frozen contingency explicitly triggers redesign.
non_authority_statement: Closeout does not authorize any blocked execution action.
